desc: Redraw this chestnut squirrel as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic squirrel proportions, same face, red-brown fur with cream belly, bushy tail, holding an acorn, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on tail and acorn, subtle fur shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
